preconditions.description: The number of towns n is between 2 and 200,000.
The length of the list a is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in a is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] != i + 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: No road goes from town i to itself.

postconditions.description: The number of valid sets of roads is non-negative.
The number of valid sets of roads is less than 1,000,000,007.
The number of valid sets of roads is 2^n minus 1 minus the number of confusing sets.
